title: Change Color in Photoshop – Day 8: Targeted Hue/Saturation Edits and Colorize Techniques
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 8 lesson demonstrates how to change the color of objects in Photoshop using a hue/saturation adjustment layer, with emphasis on precise targeting via selection and masking. The tutorial covers selecting the object (a Volkswagen bus) with the Object Selection tool, loading the selection as a layer mask, and using color-based adjustments to alter hue, saturation, and lightness. It shows sampling target colors with the Eyedropper, refining edits with layer masks (painting with black to hide adjustments), and applying multiple Hue/Saturation layers to affect greens, blues, and even a blanket color using the Colorize option. The session concludes with a gradient-based mask for controlled transitions and a reminder to group layers for organization. The workflow is framed as adjustable and non-destructive, enabling quick re-tuning of colors at any time.
topics: Object Selection tool with AI features
